blocks.text: Jab jism ka darja-e-hararat 37°C se gir jata hai to jawab mein vasoconstriction, kaampna (shivering) aur metabolism ki raftar ka barhna shamil ho sakte hain. Vasoconstriction mein jild ki taraf khoon ka bahao kam ho jata hai, is liye khoon se kam hararat zaya hoti hai. Kaampna (skeletal muscles ka jhatkon se sukarna) hararat paida karta hai jo jism ka darja-e-hararat barhane mein madad deta hai. Baalon ki jar (hair follicles) ke chhote muscles sukarte hain aur rongte khare ho jate hain (goosebumps). Khare baalon mein hawa phans jati hai jo hararat ke liye insulator (hararat ko rokne wali tah) ka kaam karti hai. Metabolism ki barhi hui raftar bhi hararat paida kar ke jism ka darja-e-hararat barhati hai.

blocks.alt: See-saw 'Body Temp. 37 C (homeostasis)' ke gird do chakkar. Upar wala: darja-e-hararat maamool se barhta hai; jild aur hypothalamus ke receptors pakarte hain; hypothalamus ka control centre effectors yaani paseena (sweat production) aur vasodilation ko chalata hai; darja-e-hararat maamool par aata hai. Neeche wala: darja-e-hararat girta hai; receptors pakarte hain; control centre vasoconstriction aur kaampna (shivering) chalata hai; darja-e-hararat maamool par aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Insanon mein thermoregulation (kitab ki Figure 13.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har chakkar stimulus wale dabbe se 'Receptors (in skin & hypothalamus) detect stimulus' aur 'Information sent to control centre.' se hota hua dimagh tak jata hai jis mein hypothalamus hara nishan hai, phir effectors aur response wale dabbe tak. Garmi ke effectors: jild ka tukra jis mein lipta hua paseene ka ghadood (sweat gland) aur sath par qatra hai, 'Sweat production: Cooling by evaporation.'; aur jild jis ki khoon ki nalyan sath ke qareeb phaili hain aur hararat ke teer nikal rahe hain, 'Vasodilation: Heat radiated from skin surface.'. Thand ke effectors: jild jis ki nalyan patli aur gehri hain, 'Vasoconstriction: Blood diverted to deep tissues to minimize heat loss.'; aur skeletal muscle ke reshe, 'Shivering in skeletal muscles: Heat produced.'.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar wala chakkar garmi ka hai aur neeche wala thand ka. Dono ki tarteeb ek jaisi hai: stimulus (tabdeeli), receptors, hypothalamus ka control centre, effectors, phir response jo darja-e-hararat ko 37 C par wapas laata hai. Garmi mein paseena bhap ban kar (evaporation) jism thanda karta hai, aur jild ki nalyan phail kar (vasodilation) hararat bahar nikalti hain. Thand mein nalyan sukar kar (vasoconstriction) khoon andar bhejti hain taa ke hararat kam zaya ho, aur muscles kaanp kar (shivering) hararat banate hain.

blocks.caption: Insani rad-e-amal
rows: vasodilation: jild ke neeche capillaries phailti, sateh ke qareeb zyada khoon behta aur hararat khota hai
vasoconstriction: jild ko kam khoon jata, to kam hararat zaya hoti hai
paseena: paseene ki bukhaarat hararat le jati hai
kaampna: skeletal muscles ka jhatkedar sukarna hararat banata hai
thyroid kam thyroxine nikal sakta, basal metabolic rate aur hararat kam karta
goosebumps: baalon ke muscles sukarte aur khare baal insulating hawa rokte; metabolism barhta hai

blocks.prompt: Darja-e-hararat 37 C se barhne par insanon ki qaboo ki tadabeer bayan kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Jild ke thermoreceptors hypothalamus ko signal dete; jild ki capillaries phailti hain to zyada hararat nikalti, paseene ke glands paseena banate jis ki bukhaarat jism ko thanda karti, aur hararat kam karne ke liye thyroxine ka ifraz kam ho sakta hai; saye mein jana ya pankha chalana bhi madad deta hai.

items: Insaan negative feedback se darja-e-hararat qaboo karte hain; control centre hypothalamus hai.
Garmi: vasodilation (jild ki capillaries phailti hain, zyada khoon), paseena, thyroxine kam.
Thand: vasoconstriction, kaampna, goosebumps, metabolism tez.
Dimagh ke upar wale markaz hamein garmi ya thand mehsoos karwate hain, to hum pankha ya heater chalate hain.
